text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service inference-sidecar v1.12 -> v1.13 (wave 1/5)

alex: Seeing early healthcheck failures on new sidecars — 3/10 instances failing liveness checks, 502/503s spiking.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: P1 — canary-healthcheck-failures for inference-sidecar. @oncall

jordan: Pulling logs now. quick snapshot: upstream reset and 'kv-cache miss' bursts right before 5xx.

emily: Confirming customer-visible errors in metrics: 5xx rate up to 4% for traffic routed to canary group. Escalating.

marie: Stopping further waves and setting rollback kill flag. Running flag toggle.

marie: ```
/flag toggle inference-sidecar.fast_kv_cache --set off --reason 'canary healthcheck failures' --initiator marie
``` 

deploy-bot: Abort rule triggered: canary healthcheck failure >= 2/10, stopping rollout and scheduling rollback for canary hosts.

alex: Kicking off immediate rollback on the 3 failing canaries and draining canary traffic. Will monitor for error rate drop.

jordan: See trace sample: sidecar timed out to upstream model host after cache miss; latency spike correlates with cache eviction event.

emily: Customer impact: ~18% of requests that hit canaries saw degraded latency; small set (5 customers) experienced transient 5xx. Support informed — case numbers created.

product-ops: Notified account owners for impacted customers and opened escalation channel. Tracking: #cust-urgent-123.

alex: Rollback in progress — confirmed 2/3 canaries rolled back, one stuck in draining (OOM on agent). Eng-infra paged.

oncall-handoff: emily will remain oncall for incident; jordan to join for follow-up troubleshooting. Handoff ETA 30m.

jordan: Next steps: (1) collect kv-cache metrics, (2) repro locally with v1.13 sidecar + cache settings, (3) verify rollback fully restores 5xx to baseline.

emily: Logging timeline for postmortem and adding eval prompts to verify model-facing correctness after rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for all canary hosts at 1715004520. Monitoring for stabilization.

alex: Error rate back down to baseline in metrics — closing immediate emergency. Will open postmortem and link follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved (canary rollback) — create incident ticket and assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime for RCA.
